rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold — and sorry for the quick no. I'm not able to go on record by name right now; I have an internal process to clear before I can speak publicly about this. I'd rather wait than say something I can't stand behind later. Hope the piece goes well, and happy to stay in touch for next time. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined the reporter's (Larkin Dispatch) on-the-record quote request — her deadline was tomorrow noon.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold in this. I'm not in a position to have my name or Halcyon Threshold listed as a public signatory right now — I have an internal matter to clear first before attaching my name to anything public. I'll keep an eye out for future letters. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined Corvid Institute's open-letter sign-on request.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this is genuinely useful to hear. Here's something concrete that fits well with an analyst's eye and a few hours a week: Halcyon Threshold just put up a small curated list of time-limited AI-safety-adjacent opportunities (grants, public comment periods, compute credit programs, calls for write-ups) — live here: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app/opportunities.html If you're up for it: 1. Sanity-check the entries already there (deadlines, amounts, links). 2. Flag anything stale or wrong. 3. Suggest 2–3 more we're missing — you probably see things I don't. No fixed cadence needed, whatever fits your five hours. Thank you again for offering. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (meetup volunteer, 5 hrs/week): asked her to sanity-check and extend the Opportunities tracker

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
